Manifest.Name: 可能是按键统一优化 / Probably Unified Hotkeys
Manifest.Author: 太湖白1231
Manifest.Description:
将《深空当铺》原版与工坊模组的快捷键、常规设置合并至官方 ESC「选项」页，支持多种界面形态切换与自由设置。 【操作说明】 • 按 ESC 打开「选项」，在独立界面模式下可点击原版选项页左下角入口打开模组设置；点击目标按键直接录入，支持组合键、鼠标右键与侧键，按 Esc 设为「无」，单击鼠标左键取消。 • 修改后点击底部的「应用」保存生效；展开本模组卡片可使用 3 套本地预设槽位与剪贴板导入导出。 【主要功能】 • 统一视图：按分区折叠卡片，支持原版样式与一键「恢复默认」；支持合并至原版、模组独立界面与纯原版界面三种形态自由切换。 • 自由排布：按住卡片即可拖动调整顺序，内置 6 种卡片排序方式，排布顺序随预设方案同步保存。 • 按键增强：支持 Shift / Ctrl / Alt 组合键、鼠标右键与侧键（Mouse1~6）及空键解绑（按 Esc 设为「无」）。 • 快速检索：支持简繁中英、多音字与拼音搜索，自带 [!] 冲突集中筛选。 • 方案快照：展开本模组卡片提供 3 套本地预设槽位与剪贴板导入导出。 • 便捷反馈：支持顶部「模组排查」一键复制汇总。 • 流畅响应：优化选项页面打开速度，改造件模组封面显示加速，退出游戏与返回主菜单加速。
---
Merges vanilla and workshop mod hotkeys and settings into the official ESC "Options" menu, with customizable layout modes. [Usage] • Press ESC to open "Options" or use the bottom-left entry in standalone mode; click any key to rebind (supports combos, right click and side buttons), press Esc to set to "None", left-click to cancel. • Click "Apply" at the bottom to save; expand this mod card for 3 preset slots and clipboard import/export. [Features] • Unified View: Collapsible cards matching native style with per-section "Reset to Default"; switch freely between Merged, Standalone, and Vanilla-only display layouts. • Flexible Ordering: Drag cards to reorder with 6 built-in sort modes, saved with profile presets. • Enhanced Keybinds: Supports Shift / Ctrl / Alt combos, mouse right click and side buttons (Mouse1~6), and unbinding to "None" (Esc). • Fast Search: Search via Chinese (Simp/Trad), polyphone pinyin, or English with [!] conflict filter. • Profile Presets: 3 local preset slots and clipboard import/export inside this mod card. • Diagnostics Summary: One-click "Diagnostics" summary copy at the top bar for easy feedback. • Faster Response: Optimized Options menu opening, faster mod preview loading, and quicker main menu return and game quit.
